whyCym: Mae’r arddodiad “o” fel arfer yn achosi treiglad meddal ar enw lle Cymraeg sy’n ei ddilyn. Dim ond rhai llythrennau sy’n cael eu heffeithio gan y treiglad meddal. Dyma’r newidiadau: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → diflannu, LL → L, RH → R, ac M → F.

why: The preposition "o" normally causes a soft mutation on Welsh names that follow it. However, soft mutation only affects words beginning with C, P, T, B, D, G, Ll, Rh and M. So, this word is not affected
whyeng: The preposition "o" normally causes a soft mutation on Welsh names that follow it. However, soft mutation only affects words beginning with C, P, T, B, D, G, Ll, Rh and M. So, this word is not affected
whyCym: Mae’r arddodiad “o” fel arfer yn achosi treiglad meddal ar enwau Cymraeg sy’n ei ddilyn. Fodd bynnag, dim ond ar eiriau sy’n dechrau gyda C, P, T, B, D, G, Ll, Rh ac M y mae treiglad meddal yn effeithio. Felly, nid yw’r gair hwn yn cael ei dreiglo.
whycym: Mae’r arddodiad “o” fel arfer yn achosi treiglad meddal ar enwau Cymraeg sy’n ei ddilyn. Fodd bynnag, dim ond ar eiriau sy’n dechrau gyda C, P, T, B, D, G, Ll, Rh ac M y mae treiglad meddal yn effeithio. Felly, nid yw’r gair hwn yn cael ei dreiglo.

whyeng: The preposition “yn” (“in”) normally causes a nasal mutation on the Welsh place name that follows it. However nasal mutation only affects the following letters: C becomes NGH, P becomes MH, T becomes NH, B becomes M, D becomes N, and G becomes NG.
whyCym: Mae’r arddodiad “yn” (“in”) fel arfer yn achosi treiglad trwynol ar enw lle Cymraeg sy’n ei ddilyn. Fodd bynnag, dim ond ar y llythrennau canlynol y mae’r treiglad trwynol yn effeithio: mae C yn dod yn NGH, P yn MH, T yn NH, B yn M, D yn N, a G yn NG.

whyeng: The preposition "o" or "from" normally causes a soft mutation on the Welsh place name that follows it. Soft mutation only affects certain initial letters. In Welsh, these changes are: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → disappears, LL → L, RH → R, and M → F.

why: The preposition "o" or "from" normally causes a soft mutation on the Welsh place name that follows it. Soft mutation only affects certain initial letters. In Welsh, these changes are: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → disappears, LL → L, RH → R, and M → F.
whyeng: The preposition "o" or "from" normally causes a soft mutation on the Welsh place name that follows it. Soft mutation only affects certain initial letters. In Welsh, these changes are: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → disappears, LL → L, RH → R, and M → F.
whyCym: Mae’r arddodiad “o” fel arfer yn achosi treiglad meddal ar enw lle Cymraeg sy’n ei ddilyn. Dim ond rhai llythrennau sy’n cael eu heffeithio gan y treiglad meddal. Dyma’r newidiadau: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → diflannu, LL → L, RH → R, ac M → F.
whycym: Mae’r arddodiad “o” fel arfer yn achosi treiglad meddal ar enw lle Cymraeg sy’n ei ddilyn. Dim ond rhai llythrennau sy’n cael eu heffeithio gan y treiglad meddal. Dyma’r newidiadau: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → diflannu, LL → L, RH → R, ac M → F.

why: The preposition "o" or "from" normally causes a soft mutation on the Welsh place name that follows it. Soft mutation only affects certain initial letters. In Welsh, these changes are: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → disappears, LL → L, RH → R, and M → F.
whyeng: The preposition "o" or "from" normally causes a soft mutation on the Welsh place name that follows it. Soft mutation only affects certain initial letters. In Welsh, these changes are: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → disappears, LL → L, RH → R, and M → F.
whyCym: Mae’r arddodiad “o” fel arfer yn achosi treiglad meddal ar enw lle Cymraeg sy’n ei ddilyn. Dim ond rhai llythrennau sy’n cael eu heffeithio gan y treiglad meddal. Dyma’r newidiadau: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → diflannu, LL → L, RH → R, ac M → F.

whyeng: The preposition "o" normally causes a soft mutation on Welsh names that follow it. However, soft mutation only affects words beginning with C, P, T, B, D, G, Ll, Rh and M. So, this word is not affected
whyCym: Mae’r arddodiad “o” fel arfer yn achosi treiglad meddal ar enwau Cymraeg sy’n ei ddilyn. Fodd bynnag, dim ond ar eiriau sy’n dechrau gyda C, P, T, B, D, G, Ll, Rh ac M y mae treiglad meddal yn effeithio. Felly, nid yw’r gair hwn yn cael ei dreiglo.
whycym: Mae’r arddodiad “o” fel arfer yn achosi treiglad meddal ar enwau Cymraeg sy’n ei ddilyn. Fodd bynnag, dim ond ar eiriau sy’n dechrau gyda C, P, T, B, D, G, Ll, Rh ac M y mae treiglad meddal yn effeithio. Felly, nid yw’r gair hwn yn cael ei dreiglo.

why: The preposition "o" or "from" normally causes a soft mutation on the Welsh place name that follows it. Soft mutation only affects certain initial letters. In Welsh, these changes are: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → disappears, LL → L, RH → R, and M → F.
whyeng: The preposition "o" or "from" normally causes a soft mutation on the Welsh place name that follows it. Soft mutation only affects certain initial letters. In Welsh, these changes are: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → disappears, LL → L, RH → R, and M → F.
whyCym: Mae’r arddodiad “o” fel arfer yn achosi treiglad meddal ar enw lle Cymraeg sy’n ei ddilyn. Dim ond rhai llythrennau sy’n cael eu heffeithio gan y treiglad meddal. Dyma’r newidiadau: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → diflannu, LL → L, RH → R, ac M → F.
whycym: Mae’r arddodiad “o” fel arfer yn achosi treiglad meddal ar enw lle Cymraeg sy’n ei ddilyn. Dim ond rhai llythrennau sy’n cael eu heffeithio gan y treiglad meddal. Dyma’r newidiadau: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → diflannu, LL → L, RH → R, ac M → F.

why: The preposition "o" or "from" normally causes a soft mutation on the Welsh place name that follows it. Soft mutation only affects certain initial letters. In Welsh, these changes are: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → disappears, LL → L, RH → R, and M → F.
whyeng: The preposition "o" or "from" normally causes a soft mutation on the Welsh place name that follows it. Soft mutation only affects certain initial letters. In Welsh, these changes are: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → disappears, LL → L, RH → R, and M → F.
whyCym: Mae’r arddodiad “o” fel arfer yn achosi treiglad meddal ar enw lle Cymraeg sy’n ei ddilyn. Dim ond rhai llythrennau sy’n cael eu heffeithio gan y treiglad meddal. Dyma’r newidiadau: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → diflannu, LL → L, RH → R, ac M → F.
whycym: Mae’r arddodiad “o” fel arfer yn achosi treiglad meddal ar enw lle Cymraeg sy’n ei ddilyn. Dim ond rhai llythrennau sy’n cael eu heffeithio gan y treiglad meddal. Dyma’r newidiadau: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → diflannu, LL → L, RH → R, ac M → F.

why: The preposition “yn” (“in”) normally causes a nasal mutation on the Welsh place name that follows it. However nasal mutation only affects the following letters: C becomes NGH, P becomes MH, T becomes NH, B becomes M, D becomes N, and G becomes NG.
whyeng: The preposition “yn” (“in”) normally causes a nasal mutation on the Welsh place name that follows it. However nasal mutation only affects the following letters: C becomes NGH, P becomes MH, T becomes NH, B becomes M, D becomes N, and G becomes NG.
whyCym: Mae’r arddodiad “yn” (“in”) fel arfer yn achosi treiglad trwynol ar enw lle Cymraeg sy’n ei ddilyn. Fodd bynnag, dim ond ar y llythrennau canlynol y mae’r treiglad trwynol yn effeithio: mae C yn dod yn NGH, P yn MH, T yn NH, B yn M, D yn N, a G yn NG.
whycym: Mae’r arddodiad “yn” (“in”) fel arfer yn achosi treiglad trwynol ar enw lle Cymraeg sy’n ei ddilyn. Fodd bynnag, dim ond ar y llythrennau canlynol y mae’r treiglad trwynol yn effeithio: mae C yn dod yn NGH, P yn MH, T yn NH, B yn M, D yn N, a G yn NG.

why: The preposition "o" or "from" normally causes a soft mutation on the Welsh place name that follows it. Soft mutation only affects certain initial letters. In Welsh, these changes are: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → disappears, LL → L, RH → R, and M → F.

why: The preposition "o" or "from" normally causes a soft mutation on the Welsh place name that follows it. Soft mutation only affects certain initial letters. In Welsh, these changes are: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → disappears, LL → L, RH → R, and M → F.
whyeng: The preposition "o" or "from" normally causes a soft mutation on the Welsh place name that follows it. Soft mutation only affects certain initial letters. In Welsh, these changes are: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → disappears, LL → L, RH → R, and M → F.
whyCym: Mae’r arddodiad “o” fel arfer yn achosi treiglad meddal ar enw lle Cymraeg sy’n ei ddilyn. Dim ond rhai llythrennau sy’n cael eu heffeithio gan y treiglad meddal. Dyma’r newidiadau: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → diflannu, LL → L, RH → R, ac M → F.

why: The preposition "o" or "from" normally causes a soft mutation on the Welsh place name that follows it. Soft mutation only affects certain initial letters. In Welsh, these changes are: C → G, P → B, T → D, B → F, D → DD, G → disappears, LL → L, RH → R, and M → F.
